title: Kestrel Auto Finance Credit Policy — Cash Down Amount on Vehicle Purchase Agreements Orders
content:
**Definition.** On an order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements financed through Kestrel Auto Finance, the cash down is the required down payment less the down payment credits, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.

**Required down payment.** The larger of the contract tier's minimum down payment in dollars and the tier's minimum down payment percentage of the vehicle price charged on the order net of any reversal, the percentage amount rounded half up to the cent. Both tier minimums are those of the order's approved contract in Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts.

**Down payment credits.** The credits are:
- the reservation deposit applied to the order; and
- the equity of an accepted trade-in agreement linked to the order, which is its current offer less the latest payoff quote recorded on it, never below zero.

**Worked examples (hypothetical; the tier minimums of 10 percent and $2000.00 are illustrative inputs, not a published tier).**

| | Example A | Example B | Example C |
|---|---|---|---|
| Vehicle price charged, net | $28000.00 | $15000.00 | $21000.00 |
| Percentage amount (10 percent) | $2800.00 | $1500.00 | $2100.00 |
| Required down payment (larger of percentage amount and $2000.00) | $2800.00 | $2000.00 | $2100.00 |
| Deposit applied | $500.00 | $500.00 | $500.00 |
| Trade-in: current offer, latest payoff quote | $6000.00, $4800.00 | $3000.00, $3500.00 | $9000.00, $2000.00 |
| Trade equity | $1200.00 | $0.00 | $7000.00 |
| Cash down | $1100.00 | $1500.00 | $0.00 |

In Example C the credits of $7500.00 exceed the required $2100.00, and the cash down stops at zero.
